title: OpenCode
checking: Checking hardware, OpenCode, and its GChat provider configuration…
desktopOnly: Code is available in the GChat desktop app.
unsupportedHardware: This system is not supported by the current GInfer runtime.
notInstalled: OpenCode is not installed. Install it from Integrations, then return here.
wslOnly: OpenCode was found only inside WSL. Install a native Windows copy to use the embedded ConPTY terminal.
missingConfiguration: OpenCode is installed but has not been configured for the local GChat provider.
invalidConfiguration: The OpenCode configuration could not be read. Fix it from Integrations before starting Code.
workspaceUnavailable: The Code workspace is not available.
stopTimeout: The existing Code terminal did not stop in time.
replayUnavailable: The terminal was detached long enough to lose exact screen state. Restart OpenCode for a clean display.
